title: Moonlit Dreamweaver
description: A luminous crescent moon dominates the cosmic scene with a translucent female figure sitting on its edge, reaching toward a glowing green star. In the foreground, three reflective blue spheres rest on a rippling dark blue surface, each containing miniature crescent moons within their glossy orbs.
prompt: A surreal cosmic scene featuring a large glowing crescent moon against a purple starry sky, with a translucent female figure with flowing purple hair sitting on the moon's edge and reaching for a bright green star. In the foreground, three highly reflective blue spheres of different sizes sit on a dark blue rippling surface, each containing a tiny glowing crescent moon inside. Nebulae and small floating orbs fill the background, magical and ethereal atmosphere, digital painting style.
